function: Predicts the angular power spectral density of channels at unknown frequency bands from measured channels in other bands, i.e. frequency-domain channel prediction (p. 3).
system: MISO sounder: one omnidirectional Tx antenna, Rx 4x4 (0.7 GHz) or 4x8 (2.3, 3.7 GHz) planar arrays; sub-6 GHz bands; no RIS (p. 8, Table I).
method: Autoencoder plus coupling Conv-GRU cells per cluster type (LoS, single-bounce, multi-bounce); supervised training on measured angular PSDs, MAE loss (p. 5, 7, 9).
data_channel: Own measurements at 0.7, 2.3, 3.7 GHz, Purple Mountain Laboratories, 12350 samples (p. 9); Wireless InSite ray-tracing office, 2.5-6 GHz (p. 13).
test_conditions: Interpolation: train on lowest and highest band, test on middle band; extrapolation: train lower bands, test higher; Case 2 trains and tests on different streets (p. 9-12).
baselines: Only learned: general LSTM, GRU-based and Conv-LSTM-based variants of the same network; no classical non-learned method (p. 10-11, Table III).
metrics: RMSE, MAPE and NMSE between predicted and measured angular PSDs (p. 10-11, Table III).
complexity: 620,705 parameters in the proposed model (p. 9); no FLOPs or runtime reported.
q1_support: p. 8: "both the training data and testing data are collected from the channel measurements"
q2_support: p. 12: "the training and validating data used in Case 2 simulations are collected from different streets"
q3_support: p. 10: "LSTM [47] and GRU [48], [49], are conducted as comparison methods"; Table III (p. 11) lists only learned networks, so no non-learned baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the total number of parameters in the proposed model is 620,705"
q5_support: p. 8: "both the training data and testing data are collected from the channel measurements"; no link or DOI for code or data is given, so the mark rests on the measured-data clause.
notes: Area 2: the method predicts and synthesizes the channel (angular PSD) across frequency bands from the authors' own measurements; link is MISO (one Tx antenna, Rx arrays), so not single-antenna (p. 8, Table I). q3 is 0 because Table III (p. 11) has only learned networks and the ray-tracing simulator is a performance bound, not a baseline (p. 13). q5 is 1 only through the measured-data clause of the instructions: the data are the authors' own measurements, with no release link, so the reviewer should confirm.
